rules.broken: 20+ ratings, 70%+ one-star in the deciding window, and under 60% of users ever rendered a game window on Adreno + Turnip in the telemetry window
rules.likely_broken: 50%+ one-star in the deciding window and under 60% rendered, or 70%+ one-star with no telemetry (under 10 users)
rules.fix_pending: a config overlay fixed this game and fewer than 10 ratings arrived after the fix; off the broken lists for up to 30 days from the fix start
rules.first_run_friction: 50%+ one-star but 60%+ of users render the game eventually
rules.window: post-fix ratings when a config overlay fixed the game and 10+ arrived, else the last 14 days when they hold 20+, else the last 20 ratings at any age (verdict_window = post_fix | recent | last_20)
rules.order: one-star ratings per day in the deciding window, highest first
rules.recovered: the 90-day history alone would put the game on a broken list, but the deciding window (5+ ratings) is under 50% one-star
rules.release_regression: the newest release renders for under 60% of its 10+ users and at least 20 points under the telemetry window
